ModMetaData.name: Body Fit – Bodies, Clothes, Armor, Hair and Weapons Fix
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Fixes heads, bodies, clothes, hair and weapons for every race and every body type in your game – vanilla, body mods and Humanoid Alien Races. Nothing is hard-coded for particular mods; everything is checked against what really exists.
- Heads in the middle of the body: body types without a head position get the position of the most similar body. Set your own head position per body type and per race. - Bodies that cannot be drawn (missing body picture, or a body type the race does not have) get the most similar working body. You can pick the body per race. - Clothes with no picture for a body use the picture of the most similar body – no pink squares, no invisible clothes, no errors. Set your own replacement body per body type (e.g. FemaleBB → Female). - Borrowed clothes pictures are moved and scaled to the outline of the real body. - Hair: missing hair pictures are drawn as short hair instead of pink squares; hair height and size per race. - Hats and helmets sit on the real head, weapons are held at the real body. - Clothes tab: hide any piece of clothing, or move and resize it yourself. - Preview tab: see a colonist before and after the fixes from all four sides. - Report button: writes every body, race and missing clothes picture to Player.log.
- Refitting for body mods (FemaleBB, Beautiful Bodies …): clothes drawn for the normal body are redrawn to the real outline of the modded body – shoulders, hips and waist are covered, capes and loose cloth keep their shape. On by default. - Alien races (Humanoid Alien Races): clothes are fitted only when the race's body really is a human-like body. Races whose body picture is something else (tentacles, a tail, wings, a big aura) keep their clothes exactly as the race mod draws them; small "chibi" races get clothes scaled to their size. Refitting for alien races is an experimental option, off by default – check the result in the Preview tab.
Since 2.3.0 only the human race is changed by default. Alien races are drawn exactly as their own mod draws them, so nothing of theirs gets broken – switch on any race you want fixed in the Races tab (a race whose body cannot be drawn at all is still repaired).
Works with or without Humanoid Alien Races. Safe to add or remove at any time.
